titles.title: Ranchos Church, Front

description: A traditional adobe church with two bell towers stands in a desert landscape. The church is visible behind an adobe wall with a gate at its center. A bright blue sky dotted with white clouds stretches above the church and tan-colored ground sits below.
title: Ranchos Church, Front
